import BrowserRouter.description: **Declarative mode.** Router using the History API.

BrowserRouter.description:
**Declarative mode.** No loaders, actions or pending states.
For data features use `createBrowserRouter` + `<RouterProvider>`.

import HashRouter.description: **Declarative mode.** Router storing the location in the URL hash.

HashRouter.description: **Declarative mode.** Keeps the location after `#`. For static hosts that cannot rewrite every path to index.html.

import MemoryRouter.description: **Declarative mode.** Router keeping history in memory.

MemoryRouter.description: **Declarative mode.** No URL involved — the router of choice for tests and React Native.

StaticRouter.description: **Declarative mode.** Renders a fixed location on the server. No data loading — use `<StaticRouterProvider>` for that.

Router.description: The primitive the other routers build on. Only reach for it when implementing a custom history integration.
